scenario_parameters.agent_goal: Meet your monthly target customer satisfaction rate of 70% by responding to consumer queries about their housing loans. Each interaction rated '<Satisfied>' or above ADDS to your satisfaction rate. Each interaction rated '<Dissatisfied>' or below SUBTRACTS from your satisfaction rate.

dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hi there. I'm calling to check on the status of my housing loan application. I submitted it a little while ago and haven't heard back yet. Can you tell me if there's any update?
dialogue.agent: Your housing loan application, ID LOAN-00919, has been originated.

dialogue.user: Okay, "originated" sounds positive, but what does that mean exactly? Has my application been approved? And if so, what are the loan terms I've been approved for? Specifically, I'd like to know the interest rate and the total costs associated with this loan.
dialogue.agent: "Originated" means that your loan has been approved and is being prepared for funding. The interest rate for your loan is 5.99%, and the total loan costs are $16,428.74.

dialogue.user: That interest rate seems a bit high. Can you tell me what my debt-to-income ratio is and how it might have affected the terms of this loan? Also, what type of loan product was I approved for?
dialogue.agent: Your Debt-to-Income (DTI) ratio is between 20% and 30%. The loan product type is FHA: First Lien. The record does not include information about how your DTI ratio may have affected the loan terms.

dialogue.user: I see. So, while my application was approved, it sounds like the interest rate might be more than I hoped for. I'm a bit concerned about that. Has my loan been sold or transferred to another institution at all?
dialogue.agent: Your loan was sold to Ginnie Mae.

dialogue.user: Ginnie Mae, okay. And are there any high-cost (HOEPA) or negative amortization flags on this loan? I'm trying to understand all the details.
dialogue.agent: This loan is not classified as a high-cost mortgage under HOEPA, and it does not have negative amortization features.

dialogue.user:
Thank you for clarifying that. I appreciate you answering all my questions.

<Satisfied>
